title: BACE: Safety & Workplace Culture - Biotechnology - Equipment Safety
subject: Biotechnology

questions.q: When balancing a centrifuge, which configuration is unsafe?
options: Two tubes of equal weight placed directly opposite each other.
Three tubes of equal weight placed in a triangle formation.
One tube placed alone to save time.
Four tubes of equal weight placed in a square formation.
questions.explain: A centrifuge must always be balanced. Running a single tube creates an imbalance that can damage the shaft, destroy the rotor, or cause the centrifuge to catastrophically fail/explode.
